init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training with NCCL or Gloo backend using environment variables for process group setup
setup_env_vars: set default environment variables for distributed training including WORLD_SIZE, RANK, MASTER_ADDR, and NCCL error handling
train_distributed: train a model across multiple processes using DistributedTrainer with GPU or CPU support
configure_gpu_device: configure CUDA device index based on local rank for distributed GPU training
review_DistributedTrainer: review the DistributedTrainer class that extends ClassyTrainer for multi-process distributed training
